## Change / 變更

Describe the outcome and why it belongs in this repository.

說明這次變更要達成的結果，以及它為何屬於本 repo。

## Evidence / 驗證證據

- Commands run / 執行指令：
- Results / 結果：
- CI, screenshot or artifact link / CI、畫面或 artifact 連結：
- Known limits or checks not run / 已知限制或未執行檢查：

## AI assistance / AI 協作揭露

- [ ] No AI assistance was used.
- [ ] AI assisted with analysis, implementation, tests, documentation or debugging.

If AI was used / 若使用 AI：

- AI contribution / AI 協助內容：
- Human review performed / 人工審核內容：
- Suggestions corrected or rejected / 已修正或拒絕的建議：
- Evidence used to verify the result / 驗證結果所用證據：

## Claim and safety review / Claims 與安全檢查

- [ ] I reviewed the diff and preserved unrelated user changes.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, generated databases or personal practice files are included.
- [ ] Dry runs, parses and plans are not described as live execution.
- [ ] Cloud and production claims match the linked evidence.
- [ ] Destructive or externally visible actions were explicitly authorized.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior, operating steps or resume claims changed.
